title: Hosea
author: Hosea son of Beeri.
historicalSetting: Hosea uses covenant marriage imagery to expose Israel's unfaithfulness and reveal God's pursuing love.
keyVerse: Hosea 6:1 — "Come, and let us return to Yahweh."
christFocus: Hosea points to Christ by revealing God's redeeming love for the unfaithful and His mercy that restores His people.
